name: Sanidhya Kashyap
one_sentence_summary: Sanidhya Kashyap leads RS3Lab at EPFL, building performant, scalable, and robust systems software spanning OS kernels, concurrency, memory management, file systems, fuzzing, and networks for modern heterogeneous hardware.
matrix_summary: RS3Lab has a new paper accepted to CIDR'27 (*"Know Thy State"*) — the lab's first acceptance at this prestigious data systems conference. Additionally, a new arXiv preprint on efficient KV caching for LLMs (*CacheWeave*) hints at a potential new research direction in ML systems.
